chapter: To the US and the Caribbean with Carmen and Rolando
title: Dominican merengue orchestras
summary: Camero recalls the great merengue orchestras: San Jose, Angelita, Angel Viloria, Joseito Mateo and Alberto Beltran.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What memory do you have of the great merengue orchestras of the time? Do you remember some of them.
Were there great merengue orchestras back then.
O yes, very good indeed. Very good. There was ...
The San Jose. Another very famous - two more - two more that were famous. The San Jose . . .
Aha, the director was Papa Molina I believe. And well, the small conjuntos, yes, Angel Viloria.
Mateo Joseito too. Then came, well that was much later, Alberto Beltran . . .
. . . who recorded with La Sonora Matancera, El Negrito del Batey. Very good, very good. Yes.
